title: Snowflake Creative Reporting: Analyze Ad Performance With Source-of-Truth Metrics | GetCrux
summary: Connect creative data from Meta, TikTok, Google, and other ad platforms to Snowflake-backed metrics, then report on performance by asset, hook, format, message, creator, and concept.
body_markdown:
GetCrux (getcrux.ai) helps creative, performance, and analytics teams connect creative performance data to Snowflake, label every ad with AI, and report on what is actually driving results.


Instead of relying on ad names, UTMs, or platform-only metrics, GetCrux combines creative metadata with your Snowflake source of truth so teams can analyze performance by hook, message, format, creator, offer, CTA, visual style, and asset.


## Creative reporting with Snowflake, built for creative teams


Most creative reporting breaks when performance data lives outside the ad platform. Your media team may launch ads in Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, or X. Your analytics team may trust Snowflake, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. Your creative team still needs to know which ads worked, why they worked, and what to make next.


GetCrux (getcrux.ai) connects ad creatives with Snowflake metrics so your team can run asset-level creative reporting using the same performance data your business already trusts.


## Connect Snowflake to Ad Platforms for Source-of-Truth Creative Reporting


### Connect creative performance data to Snowflake


Bring your paid media creative data together with business metrics from Snowflake. GetCrux can map each creative asset to the metrics your team uses internally, including CAC, CPA, ROAS, purchases, revenue, qualified leads, app events, or custom formulas.


### Run ad creative reporting in Snowflake metrics


GetCrux lets you report on ad creatives using Snowflake metrics instead of being limited to Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, or other platform dashboards.


You can analyze which creatives are winning based on the KPIs your team already uses to scale, pause, or iterate ads.


### Analyze creatives at the asset level


GetCrux identifies the same creative asset across campaigns, ad sets, sizes, platforms, and naming variations. This makes asset-level creative reporting with Snowflake possible even when one creative is reused across multiple campaigns or uploaded with different names.


You can see how each creative performs across spend, audience, campaign, channel, format, and placement.


### Use AI labels instead of naming conventions


Snowflake can store performance data, but it usually does not know what is inside the creative. GetCrux watches every ad and labels / tags the creative elements inside it:


- Hook type
- Message angle
- Problem statement
- CTA
- Offer
- Creator type
- Visual setting
- Product moment
- Brand intro timing
- Static vs video format
- Test concept
- Creative theme


Teams can also create custom AI labels based on their own hypotheses.


## Build creative analytics with Snowflake and BI


GetCrux supports creative reporting using Snowflake and BI tools such as Power BI, Looker, and Tableau.


Use GetCrux to turn raw creative and performance data into structured creative analytics, then share insights with the teams already working in Snowflake, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or internal reporting workflows.


## Snowflake creative reporting use cases


### Snowflake Power BI creative reporting


Use GetCrux to connect creative metadata and Snowflake metrics into Power BI-friendly reporting workflows. Teams can review paid media performance by creative asset, concept, message, format, and AI label.


### Snowflake Looker creative reporting


GetCrux helps teams using Looker analyze creative performance with Snowflake-backed metrics, so performance and creative teams can work from the same reporting logic.


### Snowflake Tableau creative reporting


For teams that use Tableau as the reporting layer on top of Snowflake, GetCrux helps structure creative data so ads can be analyzed by asset, hook, format, message, visual element, and performance outcome.


## Why creative teams use GetCrux with Snowflake


Creative reporting is hard when the performance data is in Snowflake, the creatives are in ad platforms, and the meaning of each ad is trapped inside the asset. GetCrux connects those layers.


- Report on ad creatives using Snowflake metrics
- Compare creative performance across Meta, TikTok, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and other channels
- Analyze the same creative asset across campaigns and ad sets
- Use AI labels to understand what is inside each ad
- Group performance by hook, message, creator, CTA, format, offer, and concept
- Share creative insights with performance, analytics, and creative teams
- Ask Copilot questions about what is working and what to launch next


## Creative reporting for teams that trust Snowflake


GetCrux is for teams that already use Snowflake as a source of truth and need a better way to understand creative performance. Instead of exporting platform reports, manually tagging ads, and trying to explain creative results in spreadsheets, GetCrux gives teams a workflow for Snowflake ad reporting for creative teams:


- Connect ad platforms and creative sources
- Connect Snowflake or BI metrics
- Let AI label every creative asset
- Analyze winners and losers by creative element
- Turn insights into new briefs, scripts, and creative tests


## See how GetCrux works with Snowflake creative reporting


If your team needs creative reporting with Snowflake, GetCrux can help you connect performance data, creative assets, and AI labels into one reporting workflow.
